short: Determinant of an operator scalar on each block

lean.name: Formalism.ThetaLiftIndependence.DetBlocks
lean.plain: Determinant of an operator scalar on each block
lean.note: If an operator acts by a scalar on each summand of a direct sum, its determinant is the product of those scalars raised to the dimensions of their summands. The declaration records the block calculation behind determinant factorisation and sits outside the final dependency cone.
